comment: Shared oracle for RFC 0024 T1's acquisition_ratio (Python) / acquisitionRatio (TypeScript). Both backend/tests/test_cross_boundary.py and frontend/lib/__tests__/acquisition.test.ts load THIS file and assert their own language's implementation against it, so the two implementations cannot drift the way mcp-server/src/condition-pricing.ts's multiplier table once did (each side had only its own hardcoded expectations; CLAUDE.md records the incident). This file lives under shared/test-fixtures/ rather than shared/ directly: it is a test-only oracle, never read at runtime by either the backend or the frontend build, unlike shared/tool-contract.json which both processes read live. money-like fields (market, cost, expected) are strings, or null, so both a Python Decimal parser and a JS Number parser read the identical exact value with no float round-trip through JSON's number type.
